title: RequestRouter: Request-Boundary Routing for Efficient Single-GPU LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2605.23057v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: RequestRouter is a lightweight request-boundary controller for reducing the latency and energy cost of single-GPU large language model inference. Rather than serving all requests with one static configuration, the system uses cheap request-level features to select one fixed inference mode per request, including FP16, quantized inference, speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, and hybrid modes such as GPTQ plus prefix caching and INT8 plus continuous batching. We evaluate RequestRouter using an 8B instruction-tuned language model served through vLLM on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. Across the full-scale A100 evaluation--26,500 fixed-mode evaluations followed by 3,500 online-controller evaluations, for 30,000 measured inference executions in total--the controller achieves a 2.10x mean latency speedup over FP16 and a 0.48x energy ratio on deployment-style workloads. translated_title: RequestRouter：面向高效单GPU大语言模型推理的请求边界路由
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2605.23057v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：RequestRouter是一个轻量级的请求边界控制器，旨在降低单GPU大语言模型推理的延迟和能源成本。该系统不采用单一静态配置服务所有请求，而是利用廉价的请求级特征为每个请求选择一种固定的推理模式，包括FP16、量化推理、投机解码、前缀缓存、连续批处理，以及混合模式如GPTQ加前缀缓存和INT8加连续批处理。我们使用通过vLLM在NVIDIA A100 GPU上服务的8B指令调优语言模型来评估RequestRouter。在整个A100评估中——包括26,500次固定模式评估和3,500次在线控制器评估，总计30,000次测量推理执行——控制器在部署风格工作负载上实现了相对于FP16的2.10倍平均延迟加速和0.48倍的能耗比。一项更小规模的匹配评估，通过重复测量……
tldr: RequestRouter通过基于请求级特征动态选择最优推理模式，在单GPU上实现了显著的延迟降低和能耗节省，平均延迟加速2.10倍，能耗比降至0.48倍。
en_tdlr: RequestRouter dynamically selects optimal inference modes per request based on cheap request-level features, achieving a 2.10x mean latency speedup and 0.48x energy ratio on single-GPU LLM inference.
